landing.subhero: Create dedicated holiday calendars, map out every day of your trip, and never double-book a beach day again.
landing.tryNowSubtitle: No sign-up needed. Click any day to add an event, drag to reschedule, click an event to edit or delete.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to plan a great trip
landing.featuresSubtitle: Kino is built around the way travellers actually think.
landing.feature1Desc: Keep summer getaways, winter breaks, and long weekends in separate calendars so nothing overlaps and everything stays clear.
landing.feature2Desc: From a weekend city break to a month-long road trip — add events, set times, and colour-code every moment of your itinerary.
landing.feature3Desc: Switch between views to zoom in on a single day of activities or zoom out to see your entire holiday season at a glance.
landing.feature4Desc: Plans change. Drag events to new slots, resize them, and edit every detail without losing the bigger picture.
landing.step1Body: Give your trip a name — "Maldives 2026", "Christmas in Vienna", whatever fits.
landing.step2Body: Click any day to add flights, hotel check-ins, tours, dinners, and free time.
landing.step3Body: Open Kino on your phone and follow the plan. Or ignore it and have fun anyway.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to plan your perfect holiday?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join Kino Calendars and start organising every trip — from a long weekend to a world tour.
landing.hotTripsSubtitle: Get inspired for your next adventure and start planning today.
